svg.aria-label: Polymer chain architectures: why thermosets are stronger than thermoplastics
svg.title: Polymer chain architectures: why thermosets are stronger than thermoplastics
svg.text: Polymer chain architectures: why thermosets are stronger than thermoplastics
weak secondary bonds (dotted) can be overcome by heat; covalent cross-links (red) cannot
Thermoplastic: chains held by van der Waals / H-bonds → soften on heating, re-mouldable, lower strength, creep.
Thermoset: chains tied by covalent cross-links into one giant 3-D molecule → rigid, higher modulus & heat resistance, cannot be re-melted.
